title: Data Analyst
description:
TapGoods


TapGoods is an exciting, fast-growing start-up that is revolutionizing how rental companies optimize and grow their businesses. We’re working to make it easy to rent. 


There are tens of thousands of businesses in the US that provide event, tool, audiovisual, and recreation rentals. This fragmented $722 billion global industry has not yet adopted modern systems and instead relies on pen & paper or cobbles together dated technology solutions. We’re building a solution that modernizes and dramatically improves the rental process for both businesses and their customers. 


Our product engineering team uses agile processes to continuously deliver incremental functionality on a weekly basis. We are constantly evolving, looking at every sprint as an opportunity to celebrate our success and learn how to improve. 


Data Analyst Role


We need a Data Analyst to join our team to fulfill our customers’ reporting needs. Our cloud platform provides analytics and reporting to our customers to help them manage their rental business. We’ve built a data warehouse and are moving our canned reports into embedded Power BI reports. 


This role would work closely with the product team and engineers to take our reporting to the next level. 


Responsibilities 


  • Use Power BI to create reports using our data warehouse 
  • Look for insights in our data that can provide value to our customers 
  • Maintain the Snowflake data warehouse dimensional model 
  • Be a part of our engineering team 
  • Able to work fully remote with adequate internet speeds, workspace, zoom capabilities (good mic, headset, etc.), and multiple monitors 


Requirements 


  • 1-3 years of experience with SQL 
  • Experience with Power BI or similar BI tools 
  • Experience with Power Query M 
  • Experience with Snowflake data warehouse 
  • Understanding data models for OLAP vs OLTP 
  • Experience with dimensional modeling/star schemas 
  • An unstoppable internal drive 
  • A great attitude and work ethic 
  • Solution oriented, self starter, and team player 
  • SaaS experience is a plus 


Our Culture


We are a nimble, fast-growing startup with a fully remote work environment. We have different backgrounds and life experiences that create a highly motivated, empowered and productive team. 


We are all committed to excellent work, whether it be one task or a big project - we believe in sticking things out until they are finished, and in communicating as quickly and effectively as possible when things get in the way of completing promised work. We are committed to improving the lives of our customers through our platform and our genuine care for them.

  • Create clear requirements and tasks for developers
  • Test and launch automation tools
  • Utilize AI and scripts for monitoring

Automation examples:

  • Automatic validation of application fields

  • Performance dashboards and speed tracking
  • Quality alert system
  • Real-time monitoring tools

  • Escalation handling and issue resolution
  • Motivation and team culture development

People development:

  • Selective 1:1s
  • Coaching low performers

  • Identify bottlenecks and improve processes
  • Implement best practices and standardization
  • Maintain operations documentation
  • Work with client complaints, root cause elimination

Requirements

Must-Have:

2+ years managing operational teams

  • Experience managing 20+ employees
  • Built processes from scratch
  • Preferably BPO/outsourcing/call center/EdTech

Strong systems thinking and discipline

  • SOPs, checklists, regulations, compliance
  • Precision and attention to detail
  • Ability to make difficult decisions (terminations, corrective action)

Technical competency

  • Understanding of automation & quality monitoring
  • Ability to write clear requirements for developers
  • Experience with CRM, monitoring dashboards, etc.
  • Nice-to-have: SQL basics, API logic, scripting

Analytical approach

  • Metrics: quality %, speed, productivity, error rate
  • KPI systems and reporting
  • Data-driven decision-making

Experience in hiring & onboarding


Strong Plus:

BPO/outsourcing experience (data entry, support, back office)

Quality automation experience

Technical degree (engineering / CS / math)

Six Sigma/Lean/Kaizen knowledge

Experience scaling teams from 10 → 50+

QA/Quality Management certifications

Experience with distributed remote teams

title: Infrastructure Engineer
description:
About the Client

Our client is a global technology company specialized in large-scale cloud infrastructure, automation of distributed systems, and deep integration between hardware and software.

The engineering environment is highly technical, fast-paced, and built around autonomy, ownership, and solving complex infrastructure challenges at global scale.


About the Role

We are seeking a Senior Infrastructure Engineer with a strong software engineering background and solid experience in automating complex infrastructure environments.

This is a high-impact, product-focused role , responsible for building tools, automation layers, APIs, and workflows that will be directly consumed by the company’s customers — not only internal teams.

This is not a traditional DevOps/Platform position focused on provisioning resources internally.

Here, you will be designing and engineering infrastructure automation as product , interacting with hardware, clusters, and low-level systems that power a global cloud offering.


Key Responsibilities

  • Develop tools, automations, APIs, and infrastructure workflows used directly by end customers.
  • Build automation layers that interact with physical hardware and low-level components (state management, provisioning logic, control sequences, etc.).
  • Create and maintain internal backends and integrations linking services, infrastructure, and the core platform.
  • Leverage programming languages — especially Python — to design robust and scalable automation solutions.
  • Work on the automation behind global infrastructure and distributed clusters.
  • Contribute to technical design discussions and architectural decisions.
  • Identify opportunities for improvement within the platform and proactively propose solutions.


Technical Requirements

  • Senior-level experience in software development , especially with Python.
  • Strong background in infrastructure automation and distributed environments.
  • Experience working with hardware , data centers, bare-metal environments, or infrastructure-heavy companies.
  • Solid understanding of APIs, internal workflows, provisioning automation, and backend integrations.
  • Ability to work in low-level contexts involving hardware components and state management.
  • Proven experience building solutions from scratch , not only executing predefined tasks.


Cultural & Behavioral Profile

  • High autonomy: must be able to discover opportunities, define approaches, and drive solutions independently.
  • Seniority and maturity to operate within a team of highly experienced engineers.
  • Hands-on, proactive mindset, with strong ownership and problem-solving orientation.
  • Experience in fast-paced environments (startups or mixed small/large company backgrounds).
  • Curiosity and flexibility to learn new technologies and navigate cross-disciplinary areas.


English Requirement

  • Advanced English is mandatory , as the leadership and part of the engineering team are international.


What Will Not Fit

  • Junior or mid-level professionals.
  • Candidates who only worked in slow, highly structured corporate environments.
  • Profiles focused solely on execution or maintenance (not creation).
  • Professionals who depend heavily on direction and lack technical autonomy.


Contract Model

  • PJ / Contractor (LLC) — engagement through independent contractor arrangement.
  • The candidate must be legally able to invoice through a company (LLC or equivalent).


Work Model

  • Remote (remote-friendly).
  • The company has no restrictions regarding location, as long as the candidate meets performance expectations and availability for team collaboration.


Why This Role Stands Out

  • Direct impact on the core product , not just internal tooling.
  • Unique combination of software + hardware + global infrastructure engineering .
  • High autonomy and opportunity to design new components from scratch.
  • Collaboration with a senior, highly technical engineering team.

  • Experience testing RESTful APIs, CMS integrations, or decoupled web applications.
  • Proficiency with modern testing frameworks and tools (e.g., Cypress, Playwright, Postman, Jest).
  • Familiarity with design systems and component-based testing (Storybook or similar).
  • Strong collaboration and communication skills to work effectively within agile teams.

AI-Enhanced Workflow Leverage tools like Descript, Runway, and AI caption generators to maximize output without sacrificing quality. We value efficiency and smart automation.


Top Fits Will Have:

  • Strong level of fluent English fluency (hard requirement)
  • 2+ years editing for DTC/eCommerce brands (beauty, health, or supplements ideal)
  • Portfolio demonstrating direct response ads that drove conversions (show us your winners)

  • Deep understanding of Meta/YouTube Shorts specs and algorithm-friendly editing patterns
  • Native fluency with UGC aesthetics (raw, authentic, relatable) vs. polished brand content
  • Proven ability to produce 8-12 ads per week without compromising quality

Bonus Points:

  • Understanding of direct response copywriting principles

  • Portuguese + English fluency


Non-Negotiables:

  • Fast turnaround times (24-48 hour revisions)

  • Obsessive attention to detail
  • Ego-free collaboration and receptiveness to feedback



Why Top Editors Choose Us:


Transparent Compensation Base salary + monthly performance bonuses tied to ad performance metrics. Top performers earn 20-30% above base.


Career Growth Path Start as Senior Editor → Lead Editor → Creative Director as we scale. We promote from within.


See Your Impact Daily Direct access to campaign metrics. You'll know exactly which of your ads are crushing it (and which aren't).

Buscamos uma pessoa Especialista em Email Marketing e Automação com experiência comprovada e conhecimentos técnicos, para atuar na gestão e otimização de campanhas.

Esta pessoa será responsável por impulsionar o engajamento e a maximização da receita por meio de estratégias de copys altamente otimizadas e entregabilidade através da gestão técnica de ips e senders.


I. Responsabilidades Chave e Escopo Estratégico Gestão de Automação:


Estruturar, implementar e gerenciar fluxos de automação de marketing complexos, incluindo estratégias de nutrição, retenção e reengajamento, visando a otimização do Lifetime Value (LTV). Monetização e Inbound:


Desenvolver e aplicar campanhas de Inbound Marketing, integrando o Email Marketing diretamente às estratégias de monetização de tráfego. Gestão Estratégica da Copy: Liderar a criação e otimização da Copywriting dos e-mails, com foco em objetivos de aumento de receita e métricas de engajamento. II. Proficiência Técnica e Entregabilidade (Requisito Fundamental) A pessoa deve possuir domínio técnico em: Plataformas de Email: Experiência com ferramentas de disparo e automação comparáveis a Hubspot, RD Station, SharpSpring, entre outras.


Entregabilidade: Conhecimento e experiência prática na gestão e configuração de domínios e IPs, incluindo a correta implementação e monitoramento de SPF, DKIM e DMARC, warm-ups e IP dedicado. Nuances de Infraestrutura: Entendimento técnico dos impactos da gestão de IPs e configurações de sender na saúde e taxa de entregabilidade de e-mails, bem como domínio das políticas de qualidade e boas práticas de mailing.


Otimização e Conversão: Especialização na utilização de testes A/B e multivariate para otimização contínua das taxas de abertura, clique e, crucialmente, de conversão e receita das campanhas. III. Habilidades de Liderança e Desenvolvimento Ter habilidades de compartilhar conhecimento e desenvolver pessoas que estão em fase de aprendizado. IV. Diferenciais Relevantes Serão valorizados conhecimentos ou experiências em: Utilizar ferramentas de IA como parte do processo diário.


Campanhas de Tráfego Pago e sua integração estratégica com o Email Marketing.

Modelos de Precificação e conhecimento do ecossistema de Publishers. Boa escrita e leitura em Inglês e/ou Espanhol.


Tipo de Contrato: PJ (Pessoa Jurídica)

Modalidade de Trabalho: 100% remoto, autonomia para gerenciar sua rotina com flexibilidade de horário.


Benefícios:

Acesso a plataformas de aprendizado como Alura e Udemy, para apoiar seu crescimento contínuo

Cultura de aprendizado e trocas entre equipes multidisciplinares

Remuneração: A combinar, compatível com o nível sênior da posição.

title: Game Compliance e Development Consultant
description:
SOBRE A NÓS:

A DigiPlus Interactive Corp., líder em entretenimento digital nas Filipinas, chegou ao Brasil! Iniciamos nossas operações no Brasil em 2025 com o lançamento oficial da DigiPlus Brasil Interactive Ltda., e já estamos 100% licenciados para oferecer experiências inovadoras no mercado de iGaming.

Estamos trazendo o sucesso de plataformas renomadas como a BingoPlus para criar novas oportunidades e experiências incríveis para os brasileiros.


SOBRE A ATUAÇÃO DE CONSULTORIA:

Contrato PJ temporário (3 meses) podendo ser extendido, necessário inglês avançado para atuação global.


Irá fornecer consultoria especializada para garantir que os jogos proprietários da DigiPlus (bingo, jogos instantâneos e jogos esportivos) estejam em total conformidade com as regulamentações de jogos brasileiras e tecnicamente prontos para certificação por laboratórios acreditados (GLI, BMM, eCOGRA, etc.). Atuará na intermediação entre a interpretação da regulamentação, a validação matemática e a localização para o Brasil, possibilitando uma rápida implementação comercial.


ENTREGÁVEIS ESPERADOS DA CONSULTORIA:

Alinhamento com Regulamentações e Certificações

  • Auditar jogos proprietários existentes para verificar a conformidade com as Portarias 722, 1207 e regulamentações brasileiras correlatas.
  • Desenvolver e entregar um Relatório de Avaliação de Conformidade, resumindo as lacunas e as adaptações necessárias.
  • Elaborar ou revisar a documentação técnica para submissão aos laboratórios de certificação (regras, metodologia de RNG, tabelas de RTP, lógica de pagamento).
  • Recomendar melhorias no fluxo de trabalho para agilizar a preparação para a certificação e minimizar retrabalho.


Matemática e Validação de Jogos

  • Revisar e validar os modelos matemáticos do jogo: RTP, volatilidade, curvas de pagamento e lógica de probabilidade.
  • Executar ou supervisionar simulações e testes A/B para verificar os resultados matemáticos esperados.
  • Produzir um Resumo de Validação Matemática, identificando inconsistências, riscos e ajustes recomendados.


Localização e Adaptação ao Mercado

  • Avaliar os recursos do jogo quanto à adequação cultural e comportamental ao mercado brasileiro (visuais, UX, ritmo e terminologia).
  • Fornecer um Documento de Diretrizes de Localização que descreva os ajustes necessários para melhorar o engajamento do usuário e a conformidade.
  • Aconselhar sobre ajustes nas estruturas de prêmios, equilíbrio de dificuldade e preços para padrões de jogadores locais.


Suporte Interfuncional

  • Atuar como consultor regulatório e técnico para as equipes de produto, design e conformidade.
  • Traduzir os requisitos técnicos de conformidade em tarefas de desenvolvimento acionáveis.
  • Participar de reuniões de revisão quinzenais e fornecer feedback por escrito sobre os protótipos.


RESULTADOS ESPERADOS:

  • Relatório de Avaliação de Conformidade (por linha de produto).
  • Resumo e recomendações da Validação Matemática.
  • Documento com Diretrizes de Localização.
  • Pacote de documentação técnica pronto para submissão ao laboratório de certificação.
  • Apresentação final resumindo os principais riscos, melhorias e próximos passos.


REQUITOS NECESSÁRIOS:

  • Experiência comprovada em conformidade, certificação e validação matemática (RTP, RNG e volatilidade) de jogos.
  • Familiaridade com a regulamentação brasileira de iGaming e processos de certificação de laboratórios.
  • Forte capacidade analítica e de documentação.
  • Experiência em trabalho multifuncional com estúdios, engenheiros e equipes de conformidade.
  • Inglês Avançado (necessário para lidar com Stakeholders global)


O QUE VOCÊ VAI ENCONTRAR AQUI:

  • Contrato PJ com remuneração compatível com o mercado de iGaming;
  • Ambiente global e inovador do mercado de Igaming;

description:
About the Role


The Process Optimization Partner plays a key role in transforming the People Team’s operations through technology, automation, and intelligent systems. You’ll analyse workflows, identify inefficiencies, and design scalable solutions that enhance the employee and stakeholder experience. This role blends strategic problem-solving with hands-on implementation, leveraging AI tools, process automation, chatbot systems, and dynamic knowledge bases to optimize how the People Team operates.

  • Build and manage a centralized HR knowledge base that supports employees, managers, and the People Team.
  • Develop structured documentation practices to ensure consistency and ease of information retrieval.
  • Implement taxonomy and tagging systems that enable quick search and smart recommendations.
  • Define and track key metrics related to process efficiency, automation adoption, and employee experience.
  • Use data and feedback to prioritize initiatives and communicate impact to leadership.
  • Stay current on emerging HR technologies, AI trends, and automation best practices.


Qualifications

  • 3–5+ years of experience in HR operations, process improvement, or business automation.
  • Strong understanding of HR workflows, systems, and employee experience design.
  • Hands-on experience with automation platforms (Zapier, Boomi, etc.) and/or AI assistants or chatbot builders (e.g. ChatGPT Enterprise, etc.)
  • Familiarity with HRIS platforms (HiBob, Workday, or similar).
  • Strong project management skills and the ability to translate strategy into execution.
  • Excellent written and verbal communication, with a collaborative and analytical mindset.


Preferred Qualifications

  • Experience with Hubspot CRM.
  • Exposure to AI prompt engineering, knowledge management, or digital transformation initiatives.
  • Passion for creating intuitive, efficient, and employee-friendly systems.


Success in This Role Looks Like

  • The People Team operates with greater speed, accuracy, and consistency.
  • Employees and managers can easily find answers through AI chatbots and a robust knowledge base.
  • Manual, repetitive tasks are reduced or eliminated through automation.
  • Continuous improvement becomes a core capability of the People function.

Merchandising Systems Modernization

Optimization and Allocation Systems

title: Operations Manager
description:
Role: Operations Manager (Salon, Spa, and Aesthetic industry - MUST HAVE EXPERIENCE)

Role Specifics: We are only considering candidates with experience in the Salon, Spa, and Aesthetic industry. Please apply only if you have worked in this field.

Contract: Full-time Remote Contractor (40 hours weekly / 160 hours monthly)

Business Hours: Monday to Friday, 8 AM to 5 PM EST

Rate: $12.50 - $18 USD hourly / $2,000 - $2,880 monthly (salary is negotiable based on experience and location)

Availability to Start: Immediately


Client's Profile

Founded in New Jersey in 1997, this award-winning luxury salon and wellness spa is more than a destination for beauty; it's a space for transformation, self-expression, and connection. With multiple locations and a commitment to continuous growth, they've cultivated a brand rooted in intentional service, elevated aesthetics, and deep care for their clients and team. Grounded in a culture of excellence and evolution, the company is led by a visionary founder who blends business with purpose, creating a salon experience that is as soul-filled as it is stylish. Their dedication to excellence has earned them national recognition, including features in major media outlets and accolades from platforms such as CBS and The Knot.


What You'll Do

As the Operations Manager, this role is not a traditional operations assistant role, and it's not suited for a traditional candidate. The client is building more than a business. They are nurturing a vision of trust, growth, and collaborative improvement. As the Operations Manager, you are the trusted partner who supports the founder from behind the scenes, with clear systems, executive presence, and emotional intelligence. You don't need to be perfect. But you do need to care deeply. This role blends organizational operations, systems management, and strategic support. You'll facilitate team meetings, track KPIs, manage tools like Zenoti and Shopify, coordinate marketing tasks, and keep the founder's priorities aligned. This hands-on role is ideal for someone who thrives in structure, demonstrates initiative, and prioritizes clarity and detail. Your responsibilities will include:


Operations & Integrator Coordination: 60% Role Allocation

Team & Operations Management

  • Be the primary support to the Founder in managing day-to-day operations and overall team integration.
  • Be the point of contact for internal issues and help with swift resolution.
  • Help create and implement organizational strategies that support company goals.
  • Lead planning sessions, team meetings, and 1:1s; take notes and follow up on action items.
  • Manage projects from start to finish, including timelines, budgets, and delivery.
  • Track team KPIs and tasks, offering support where needed.
  • Prepare reports on Operations and Team Performance for the Founder.
  • Identify ways to improve processes and communication, applying emotional intelligence in communication dynamics.
  • Create and maintain an easy-to-follow Operations Playbook.


System Management & Process Oversight

  • Manage internal tools like Zenoti and Qnity, including employee logs, credentials, client scheduling, cancellations, promo campaigns, etc.
  • Oversee inventory and updates in Zenoti and Shopify, ensuring stock is correct and within budget.
  • Review reports and workflows to find and fix inefficiencies.


Marketing & Content Coordination: 25% Role Allocation

Marketing Coordination

  • Coordinate marketing tasks across departments to keep campaigns on track.
  • Oversee the submission and organization of marketing materials, advertisements, and promotions within Zenoti and Shopify.


Content Curation & Social Media Management

  • Support social media efforts by duplicating and scheduling content (IG, FB, LinkedIn, Google) to align with business initiatives.
  • Write simple copy, quotes, or weekly updates as needed, ensuring consistent brand tone.
  • Monitor engagement and share relevant content ideas as needed.


Strategic Founder & Client Support: 10% Role Allocation

  • Own the Founder's calendar, meetings, and priorities; give daily updates.
  • Keep the Founder's email inbox organized, respond to messages, and track follow-ups.
  • Turn the Founder's ideas (notes or voice memos) into actionable tasks.
  • Protect the Founder's time while supporting the team and aligning priorities.
  • Communicate with clients as needed, handling urgent escalations, urgent follow-ups and building relationships.


What You Should Have

Must-haves:

  • At least seven years of experience in Executive Support, Operations, or Integrator roles, ideally supporting C-level or Founder Executives.
  • Experience supporting a Founder or Executive in a Salon, Spa, Aesthetic, or Wellness brand, particularly in fast-paced, multi-business environments.
  • At least one year of experience in a global remote or virtual environment for a company or with clients in North America, Europe, Australia, or the UAE.
  • Strong integrator and operational management skills, with the ability to translate high-level strategies into actionable plans and workflows.
  • Mastery of English communication skills, both written and verbal, with a professional tone and neutral accent for both internal coordination and client correspondence.
  • Proven ability to manage multiple workstreams, coordinate with cross-functional teams, and manage day-to-day operations.
  • Client-facing experience, with the ability to handle escalations professionally and maintain relationships.
  • Hands-on experience with Zenoti (or similar scheduling/inventory systems) and Shopify for backend coordination and updates.
  • Experience in light copywriting, editing, and scheduling social media content across IG, Facebook, LinkedIn, and Google platforms.
  • Proficient in remote office tools like Google Workspace (Docs, Sheets, Drive, Calendar) and Slack (or Teams).
  • Experience with project management tools like Asana, Notion, or ClickUp.
  • Proven experience supporting internal operations, maintaining trackers and summary reports (e.g., logins, performance, promos).
  • Exposure to process optimization frameworks, with the ability to implement improvements and create SOPs from scratch.
  • Ability to work independently, take initiative without close supervision, and keep executives focused on what matters most.


Technology Specifications:

  • Minimum 100 Mbps Internet Speed
  • Windows 11 or MacOS 15 Sequoia
  • Minimum Intel i5 8th gen with 8GB RAM or Apple M1 chip with 8GB RAM
  • Webcam and Headset
  • Designated Quiet Office Space


Nice-to-haves:

  • Experience with the Entrepreneurial Operating System (EOS) framework, including L10 meetings, Rocks, Scorecards, and IDS.
  • Basic design knowledge for editing branded visual assets in Canva.


Who You Are

We are hoping you are someone who:

  • Naturally steps in to solve problems, keep things moving, and stays a few steps ahead.
  • Thinks clearly and critically, great at untangling complex challenges, spotting what's not working, and helping build smoother systems.
  • Communicates with clarity and confidence, whether giving a quick update to the team or coordinating with external partners, you know how to get the message across with emotional intelligence.
  • Keeps everything (and everyone) on track, juggles timelines, priorities, and moving pieces with calm precision and care for the brand image.

title: Talent Manager
description:
About the Role


We are looking for an experienced Talent Manager to manage the end-to-end recruitment delivery for customer-side non-technical roles at Turing. You will be responsible for facilitating sourcing candidates, talent planning, capacity management, and internal supply optimization, while activating external sourcing channels where necessary. The ideal candidate has experience in client hiring setups, is highly organized, thrives in dynamic environments, and excels at stakeholder management.


Key Responsibilities

  • Act as the single point of contact between the Internal Delivery and Talent Fulfilment teams for assigned projects.
  • Manage end-to-end fulfilment for multiple client requirements concurrently (typically 3–4 at a time).
  • Conduct talent pool assessments and identify supply-demand gaps.
  • Activate external sourcing channels (via partnerships or talent acquisition teams) when internal supply is insufficient.
  • Oversee resource planning and capacity management, ensuring timely ramp-ups for customer-side roles.
  • Collaborate with Delivery Leads to understand project requirements and talent expectations.
  • Ensure data accuracy and visibility across systems — maintaining reports on hiring pipelines, fulfilment progress, and performance metrics.
  • Track and report fulfilment metrics, including fill rates, turnaround times, and candidate quality.
  • Partner with recruiting and sourcing teams to improve process efficiency and hiring velocity.
  • Deliver a strong stakeholder experience, maintaining proactive communication and alignment on timelines and expectations.
  • Continuously look for opportunities to improve internal talent fulfilment processes and introduce best practices.


Qualifications & Experience

  • 7–12 years of experience in talent operations, recruitment delivery, or resource planning within IT services, outsourcing, or global staffing environments.
  • Proven experience in client-side hiring setups and resource & capacity management.
  • Experience handling multiple simultaneous delivery pipelines and managing cross-functional stakeholders.
  • Working knowledge of LinkedIn Recruiter(good to have) and Google tools (Sheets, Docs, Drive) for tracking and reporting.
  • Data analysis and reporting skills — able to extract insights, identify trends, and drive data-backed decisions.
  • Excellent communication, organization, and stakeholder management skills.
  • Demonstrated ability to operate independently in a remote, fast-paced, and evolving environment.
  • Experience working across global time zones and in cross-cultural teams.


Nice to Have

  • Experience in non-technical recruitment delivery or managing customer-side talent fulfilment.
  • Exposure to capacity planning tools or reporting dashboards.
  • Prior experience in startups or high-growth organizations with minimal structure.
  • Understanding of internal mobility, workforce planning, or project-based staffing models.


Soft Skills

  • Strong stakeholder communication and collaboration skills.
  • Analytical mindset with attention to detail.
  • Adaptability — thrives in ambiguity and rapidly changing environments.
  • Proactive problem solver with a focus on ownership over hierarchy.
  • Comfortable handling multiple priorities and working under tight timelines.


Ideal Candidate Profile

The ideal candidate is a hands-on operator who thrives at the intersection of talent fulfilment, data-driven decision-making, and stakeholder management. They should be proactive, outcome-oriented, and capable of maintaining operational excellence in a remote-first, high-speed environment.

title: Paid Acquisiton Specialist
description:
Job Title: Paid Acquisition Specialist


Company:

Our client is a fast-growing digital marketing agency supporting DTC e-commerce brands across beauty, fashion, food, and pet industries. They are seeking a skilled Paid Acquisition Specialist to build, optimize, and scale full-funnel acquisition systems across Meta, TikTok, and Google.


Work Schedule: 15-20 hours/week.


This role is for someone who understands performance marketing at a systems level—not just platform execution. You’ll work cross-functionally with creative, CRO, and retention teams to deliver profitable, integrated acquisition strategies. The ideal candidate is analytical, creative, detail-oriented, and comfortable taking ownership of client growth.


Key Responsibilities

Acquisition Systems & Funnel Optimization

  • Build and manage full-funnel paid acquisition strategies for multiple DTC brands.
  • Audit and rebuild funnels to improve CAC, ROAS, MER, and LTV-based payback windows.
  • Diagnose scaling issues and implement solutions that address root-cause problems.
  • Coordinate closely with CRO to reduce friction in landing pages and improve CVR.

Campaign Management

  • Plan, launch, and optimize campaigns across Meta, TikTok, and Google Ads.
  • Own audience strategy, testing frameworks, attribution models, and budget allocation.
  • Collaborate with the creative team to develop and iterate on high-converting angles, hooks, and formats.
  • Produce insights that push creative direction and accelerate performance.

Cross-Channel Alignment

  • Work with retention teams to ensure acquisition aligns with lifecycle metrics and profitability.
  • Integrate insights from creative, CRO, and analytics to strengthen message-market fit.
  • Contribute to unified growth strategies across all channels.

Affiliate & Non-Paid Testing

  • Explore and manage affiliate partnerships, creator programs, and non-paid acquisition channels where relevant.
  • Build complementary acquisition pathways beyond paid performance.

Documentation & Continuous Improvement

  • Document all experiments, learnings, wins, and failures using internal templates.
  • Provide clear reporting focused on revenue-impacting metrics (ROAS, MER, CAC, LTV).
  • Suggest improvements to maintain system scalability and performance consistency.

Qualifications

  • 3+ years of hands-on experience managing paid acquisition for DTC brands.
  • Strong expertise in Meta, TikTok, and Google Ads.
  • Proven ability to scale brands from <$50K/month to $200K+/month profitably.
  • Strong analytical and attribution skills (MER, blended ROAS, incrementality testing).
  • Experience collaborating with creative teams and providing data-backed direction.
  • Excellent communication, reliability, and documentation habits.
  • Comfortable working independently in a fast-moving environment.

Preferred Qualifications

  • Experience with beauty, fashion, food, or pet verticals.
  • Familiarity with CRO and landing page optimization.
  • Experience running or supporting affiliate/creator programs.
  • Understanding of creative strategy and testing methodologies.

Schedule

  • Flexible working hours.
  • Remote position with ongoing collaboration across cross-functional teams.


Payments are in USD or local currency.

* Alta capacidade de comunicação oral e escrita.

* Postura confiante, analítica e orientada a decisões.

* Comunicação clara, direta e persuasiva.

* Resiliência para lidar com objeções, rejeição e volume de conversas.

* Foco em resultado, sem postura passiva.

O que não queremos: escrita fraca, oratória ruim, perfil passivo, desorganização, falta de atenção, quebra de prazos ou tarefas.

description:
Estamos em busca de uma Pessoa Desenvolvedora Back-end Node.Js- Sênior.

Você será uma peça chave no desenvolvimento de novas funcionalidades, garantindo qualidade e eficiência, além de colaborar com a equipe na definição de boas práticas de desenvolvimento. Se você curte diversão, energia, alegria, desafios criativos e é uma pessoa organizada, resolutiva, detalhista e orientada a resultados, vem com a gente!

Você será uma peça chave no desenvolvimento de novas funcionalidades, garantindo qualidade e eficiência, além de colaborar com a equipe na definição de boas práticas de desenvolvimento.



Responsabilidades:

  • Desenvolver e manter aplicações back-end em Node.Js, seguindo boas práticas de arquitetura e padrões de projeto.
  • Criar, documentar e integrar APIs RESTful de alta performance utilizando TypeScript e Express.
  • Projetar e otimizar modelagem de dados em bancos relacionais (MySQL, PostgreSQL) e/ou NoSQL (MongoDB), garantindo queries performáticas e escalabilidade.
  • Utilizar ORMs como TypeORM, Sequelize ou Prisma para manipulação eficiente do banco de dados.
  • Versionar código com Git, adotando workflows (GitFlow, pull requests, code reviews) e boas práticas de controle de versão.
  • Trabalhar com Docker e docker-compose para criar ambientes de desenvolvimento e produção consistentes e reproduzíveis.
  • Garantir qualidade de código por meio de testes automatizados (unitários e de integração) usando Jest, Mocha ou similares.
  • Implementar mecanismos de cache (Redis, Memcached) e filas de mensagens (RabbitMQ, AWS SQS/SNS, Kafka) para melhorar performance e escalabilidade.
  • Monitorar e depurar aplicações em produção utilizando ferramentas como Node Profiler, Datadog, New Relic ou Prometheus.
  • Implementar pipelines de CI/CD (GitHub Actions, GitLab CI, Jenkins) para deploy automatizado em AWS (ECS, Lambda, RDS, S3) ou Kubernetes.
  • Colaborar com times multidisciplinares (front-end, DevOps, QA) em metodologias ágeis (Scrum/Kanban), participando de planning, daily e retrospectivas.



Resquisitos:

  • Experiência sólida com Node.Js e TypeScript, aplicando padrões de projeto (Factory, Repository, Dependency Injection) e estruturação modular (Clean Architecture, DDD).
  • Uso de Express (ou NestJS/Koa) para construção de APIs, dominando rotas, middlewares, tratamento de erros e validação de payload (class-validator, Joi, Celebrate).
  • Gerenciamento de pacotes com npm ou yarn, versionamento semântico (semver) e controle de dependências.
  • Testes Automatizados: domínio de frameworks como Jest ou Mocha + Chai, testes de integração (supertest) e uso de mocks/fakes.
  • Escalabilidade e Desempenho: experiência em cache (Redis), filas de mensagens (RabbitMQ, Kafka, AWS SQS/SNS) e otimizações de consultas em bancos relacionais (índices, partições).
  • Performance e Debugging: uso de ferramentas como Node Profiler, Clinic.Js, monitoramento com Datadog, New Relic ou Prometheus/Grafana.
  • Integração Contínua e Deploy: prática com CI/CD (GitHub Actions, GitLab CI, Jenkins) e deploy em AWS (ECS, Lambda, RDS, S3) ou ambientes Kubernetes.
  • Docker Avançado: criação de imagens otimizadas, multi-stage builds e configuração de docker-compose para desenvolvimento e produção.
  • Banco de Dados Relacional Avançado: MySQL ou PostgreSQL (índices, query profiling, replicação, particionamento).
  • APIs Performáticas e Seguras: experiência com GraphQL (Apollo Server), API Gateway, autenticação/autorização via OAuth2, JWT e versionamento de APIs.
  • Git Profundo: workflows GitFlow, rebase vs merge, cherry-pick e estratégias de branching para times grandes.



Habilidades:


  • Conhecimento em PHP (Laravel, CodeIgniter, Symfony): será considerado um diferencial entender boas práticas de desenvolvimento back-end em PHP e migrar/integrações pontuais.
  • Experiência com React (ou Next.Js): habilidade para colaborar com o front-end em aplicações isomórficas ou SPA, integrando APIs e estados globais (Redux, Context API).
  • Frameworks Node.Js avançados: NestJS (dependency injection, modules, providers), Koa ou Fastify para cenários de alta concorrência.
  • Infraestrutura como Código (IaC): conhecimento em Terraform ou CloudFormation para provisionamento de ambientes AWS.
  • Monitoramento e Observabilidade: uso de ELK Stack (Elasticsearch, Logstash, Kibana), Loki/Grafana, OpenTelemetry para logs estruturados e métricas customizadas.
  • Event-Driven Architecture: trabalho com Kafka, RabbitMQ, AWS SNS/SQS, WebSockets (Socket.Io) e arquiteturas orientadas a eventos.
  • Microservices: experiência em decomposição de sistemas monolíticos, deploy independente de serviços, comunicação via mensageria e API Gateway.
  • Segurança: implementação de práticas OWASP (mitigação de SQL Injection, XSS, CSRF), configuração de WAF (Cloudflare, AWS WAF) e auditoria de código.
  • Serverless: desenvolvimento e deploy de funções AWS Lambda em Node.Js/TypeScript, integração com DynamoDB, S3 e triggers (SQS, API Gateway).

title: Preschool Teaching Assistant (Maternity Cover)
description:
JOB OVERVIEW:

The Teaching Assistant at EAC is dedicated to the school’s mission, vision, and core values, demonstrating respect for diverse cultures and learners. Teaching Assistants (TAs) play an essential role in supporting high-quality, inquiry-based international education within the Montessori and IB Primary Years Programme (PYP). Assigned to one classroom or one subject area for the school year, Teaching Assistants collaborate closely with the Specialist, Homeroom, and/or Brazilian Studies teacher to support student learning, provide individualized assistance, and foster an environment of care and belonging.


Teaching Assistants contribute to planning, instruction, assessment, and supervision, ensuring students are safe, engaged, and supported academically, socially, and emotionally. As active members of the Professional Learning Community, they participate in professional development and continuous reflection to enhance their effectiveness in supporting student growth.


ORGANIZATIONAL RESULTS:

Contribute to a safe, inclusive, and caring learning environment aligned with EAC’s mission and values.

Support the effective delivery of the school curriculum and programs by reinforcing learning and differentiated instruction.

Foster student well-being, independence, and positive relationships within the classroom and broader school community.

Model professionalism, collaboration, and ethical conduct in alignment with school policies and expectations.


CORE RESPONSIBILITIES:


Instructional Support and Student Learning

Collaborate with the classroom teacher to plan and deliver structured learning experiences for the whole class, small groups, and individual students.

Support students in understanding and reinforcing concepts introduced by the teacher, promoting independence and confidence in learning.

Prepare and organize resources, adapting materials and strategies to meet diverse student needs and cultural backgrounds.

Assist in providing formative feedback and collecting academic and behavioral data as directed by the teacher.

Participate in meetings and conferences, sharing relevant insights on student learning and providing translation or language support, when needed.


Student Care and Learning Environment

Help establish and maintain a positive, proactive, and fair classroom environment that promotes respect and self-management.

Supervise and support students to ensure safety and engagement during class and non-class times (breaks, lunch, transitions, etc.).

Apply logical and natural consequences in alignment with teacher expectations and school guidelines.

Communicate concerns about student well-being or behavior to the classroom teacher promptly and appropriately.

Assist in daily classroom routines including attendance, organization, and resource management.

Provide administrative support such as photocopying, filing, and preparing materials.

Request, organize, distribute materials and resources for the classroom or department as needed.

Supervise students during assigned duties (e.G., car pickup, lunch, recess) and assist during school trips and events.

Substitute for the classroom teacher as needed and ensure continuity of learning and care.

Support translation and communication between school and families when necessary, ensuring the teacher remains the primary point of contact.

Support and guide new Teaching Assistants as needed.


Professional Conduct and Growth

Model professionalism, punctuality, confidentiality, and responsible communication, including social media conduct.

Follow EAC policies, procedures, and safeguarding expectations as outlined in the Faculty/Staff Handbook.

Engage in professional development opportunities and participate in the Teaching Assistant Professional Growth and Evaluation process.

Collaborate positively with colleagues, offering support to new teaching assistants and contributing to a culture of collegiality and continuous improvement.


Additional Responsibilities

Engages in regular meetings and professional learning as part of the school’s commitment to continuous growth and collaboration.

Engage in the behavioral norms and expectations of the school.

Support student toileting needs, as per school norms, as assigned.

Follow the EAC Safeguarding Guide.


Working Conditions

Walk on paths and rough terrain

Lifting backpacks and school materials


Other duties, as assigned.


POSITION REQUIREMENTS:


  • Degree in Pedagogy, preferred
  • Five years experience working with children, preferred
  • PYP and inquiry-based teaching and learning experience (preferred)
  • English level required: B2 or above
  • Portuguese level required: B2 or above


Other Skills (Desirable):

  • Proven capacity to build relationships of trust and respect
  • Proven capacity and confidence working within a collaborative, team-oriented environment
  • Strong written, verbal, and digital communication skills
  • Strong professional organization skills

Our school is committed to safeguarding and promoting the welfare of children and young people and have developed and adopted written guidelines (Code of Conduct) for appropriate and inappropriate behavior of adults towards children. title: Sdr Outbound
description:

title: Human Resources Manager
description:
JOB OVERVIEW:

The Human Resources Manager plays a pivotal role in partnering with leadership to strategically coordinate the full employee lifecycle, from talent acquisition and onboarding to fostering continuous faculty and staff development. This role is crucial in ensuring successful integration into EAC's unique school culture and actively championing school-wide well-being initiatives.


ORGANIZATIONAL RESULTS:


Talent Development & Retention

  • Collaborates with school Leadership to monitor and administer professional development programs, ensuring alignment with local and international best practices in areas such as evidence-based instructional strategies and leadership development frameworks.
  • Maintains an accurate database of professional development experiences to inform future planning and ensure equitable allocation of resources.
  • Develops and implements career progression frameworks and provides individualized guidance in career development.
  • Proactively identifies and organizes relevant professional development opportunities (e.G., workshops, speakers, EdCamps).


Attracting & Retaining Talent

  • Manages the advertisement of positions and ensures the revision of job descriptions, interview questions, and tracking the overall hiring process, in collaboration with hiring managers.
  • Actively sources and solicits qualified applicants, reviews resumes, conducts initial and subsequent interviews, checks background on applicants, and makes recommendations to hiring managers, as requested.
  • Assists the Director of Finance and Administration in conducting compensation benchmarking and analysis, and utilizes systems to collect and analyze data on staff development, evaluation, retention, and attrition.
  • Organizes an overall calendar and individual events which recognize and celebrate the commitment of faculty & staff to EAC, fostering a positive and appreciative work environment.
  • Conducts interviews with faculty & staff as part of talent assessment and retention efforts.
  • Supporting performance reviews, tracking goal progress.
  • Actively sources and solicits qualified applicants from diverse backgrounds, reviews resumes with an equity lens, conducts initial and subsequent interviews, and makes recommendations to hiring managers, as requested, promoting a diverse candidate pool.


Supporting a Positive & Ethical Culture

  • Administers employment contracts and oversees the comprehensive onboarding process for all new staff, including a schedule of activities, and facilitates training in child protection and data protection.
  • Provides comprehensive support and resources to foreign hire staff as they settle into life in Campinas and at EAC.
  • Plans and implements outings for staff to support inclusion and celebration of the local culture of Campinas.
  • Collaborates with school Leadership to monitor and administer professional development programs, ensuring alignment with local and international best practices in areas such as evidence-based instructional strategies, leadership development frameworks, and DEIJ best practices.


Compliance and Child Protection

  • Collaborates with outsourced providers to ensure effective monitoring of EAC's complaint channel, facilitating appropriate incident reporting, including CIPA compliance.
  • Develops and delivers appropriate compliance training to staff and ensures the fully compliance with HR related laws
  • Establishes and oversees a robust school-wide system for mandatory child protection training for all EAC staff and third-party providers (liaising with counseling staff and Leadership).
  • Stays abreast of compliance-related laws and best practices in human resources, both nationally and internationally.
  • Proactively proposes and implements policy and procedure enhancements that support ethical behavior at EAC.
  • Develops and implements safer hiring protocols, including enhanced interview processes and comprehensive background, social media, and reference checks.


Wellbeing

  • Recommends a comprehensive yearly plan, in line with the school's strategic direction, articulating meaningful developments in all aspects of staff wellness.
  • Conducts research and benchmarking exercises to ensure EAC's approach to staff wellness incorporates new ideas and initiatives.
  • Establishes mechanisms for regular staff feedback on wellness initiatives, utilizing data to inform continuous improvement.
  • Collaborates with Leadership to research and recommend new benefits for inclusion in EAC's approach to staff wellness.


Health (physical and mental/emotional)

  • Develops, promotes, and publishes a comprehensive yearly plan of offerings and events at EAC that support the health and wellbeing of all faculty & staff.
  • Develops and promotes wellbeing activities for faculty & staff, making use of local resources such as guest speakers and trainers.
  • Acts as a primary resource, providing advice and guidance to staff on personal wellbeing, and sharing awareness of internal and external resources.
  • Serves as an internal consultant for faculty and staff on personal matters, such as stress management and relationships, offering evidence-based strategies and resources to support mental health and wellbeing and foster coping mechanisms.


Other duties, as assigned.


POSITION REQUIREMENTS


  • BA in Human Resources, Psychology, or related field
  • 5+ years of experience
  • HR policies, procedures, and best practices
  • Labor laws, employment regulations, and compliance (including CIPA)
  • HR Information Systems (HRIS)
  • Full recruitment and onboarding lifecycle
  • Compensation, benefits, and benchmarking
  • Professional development and training frameworks
  • Child protection and safeguarding protocols
  • Cultural competence and sensitivity.
  • Languages level requirement: B2 in English and C1 or above in Portuguese


Other Skills (Desirable):

  • Excellent communication (verbal and written)
  • Strong organizational and time management abilities
  • High attention to detail
  • Problem-solving and conflict resolution
  • Interpersonal skills and empathy
  • Confidentiality and discretion
  • Data analysis
  • Adaptability and proactivity
  • Cultural awareness and sensitivity
  • Ability to foster an inclusive and equitable workplace culture.


Child Safeguarding

Our school is committed to safeguarding and promoting the welfare of children and young people and have developed and adopted written guidelines (Code of Conduct) for appropriate and inappropriate behavior of adults towards children. We expect all staff, volunteers and other third parties to share this commitment and to review and affirm that they have read, understood, and will abide by the Code of Conduct. At our school, we use safer recruitment practice and pre-employment background checks, to maintain the highest standards of safeguarding and child safety.

title: Coordenador De Logística
description:
Sobre a Vaga:


O Coordenador de Logística é responsável por planejar, executar e otimizar a aquisição de bens e serviços relacionados à cadeia de suprimentos, garantindo qualidade, entrega pontual e eficiência de custos.     colaborar com colegas para compartilhar conhecimento e aprendizado, impulsionando a melhoria contínua.

  • Estabelecer uma rotina de Rastreamento e Acompanhamento: monitorar entregas, reclamações, ocorrências e custos extras, se houver.

Requisitos Obrigatórios:


  • Graduação em Logística, Administração de Empresas, Engenharia, Comércio Internacional ou áreas afins.

  • Compreende as necessidades do negócio.

title: Senior Backend Engineering Analyst
description:
Sinch is a global customer engagement platform that provides communication services for businesses across messaging, voice, and email. Sinch's services are used by more than 150,000 businesses, including many of the world's largest tech companies.

Join our development team as a Senior Backend Engineering Analyst ! You will be a key player in developing modern web applications and creating surprising new products for our clients. Our team focuses on building global-scale products and managing numerous direct integrations, including Meta (Facebook) for messaging. We also integrate with various platforms using APIs, queuing, and streaming technologies.


Activities

While responsibilities vary, in a general context, here's what we expect from you daily:

  • Deliver technology projects/products aligned with the company's strategic objectives (OKRs) , collaborating with the product team to suggest and develop new functionalities.
  • Architect and develop APIs for incredible conversational experiences and integrations using modern development technologies.
  • Develop and maintain scalable backend systems for a robust, global messaging platform (e.G., WhatsApp and SMS channels).
  • Collaboratively develop and enhance distributed backend services that meet our customers' needs.
  • Actively participate in discussions about product features and technical solutions to solve customer problems and scale our solution.
  • Master integrations and communications using REST APIs .
  • Practice code versioning (Git) , with experience in Pull Requests and Code Review.
  • Work effectively in a team environment-we don't build software alone!


Requirements

  • Solid experience in a functional language, preferably Elixir.
  • Experience developing RESTful and gRPC APIs .
  • Strong knowledge of distributed system architecture, data structures, algorithms, and software design patterns .
  • Practical knowledge of Agile development methodologies .
  • Solid understanding of relational databases .
  • Experience with Unit Testing and Integration Testing .
  • English is a must. You will communicate with teams around the world daily. We expect you to have good English reading skills from the start and be willing to dedicate yourself to learning the language.


We are looking for people who:

  • Enjoy working with talented teammates to raise the technical bar for the team, seeking new solutions and bringing improvements to existing processes.
  • Adapt quickly to change.
  • Have excellent communication skills for interpersonal relationships across different teams and hierarchical levels.

In short, we seek someone willing to deep-dive into the processes, culture, people, and business of Sinch Latam, always prioritizing continuous improvement and contributing to the evolution of our products and services.


Nice to have:

  • Knowledge of other functional languages like Erlang, Go, Rust, or Clojure .
  • Knowledge of other languages like Java and Kotlin .
  • Experience with distributed systems and microservices .
  • Familiarity with container technology (e.G., Docker and Kubernetes ).
  • Experience with messaging systems (e.G., RabbitMQ, Kafka, Phoenix PubSub ).
  • Knowledge of NoSQL databases (e.G., Postgres, MySQL, Redis, MongoDB, Elastic Search, etc.).



Benefits

  • Stay healthy: We cover 100% of medical and dental plans for Sinchers and eligible dependents through Bradesco Saúde.
  • Flexible benefits: With the Caju flexible benefit card, our Sinchers can choose to use benefits on food, education, and home office assistance.
  • Family first: Our Sinchers can enjoy paid maternity leave for 180 days and paternity leave for 30 days. Plus, we provide daycare assistance for kids up to five years old.
  • Everyday wellbeing: We partner with Wellhub to help Sinchers access gyms and wellness options.
  • Secure your future : Our Partnership with Prudential life insurance provides coverage for all Sinchers in the events of unexpected absences, serious illness, accidents, and disabilities.
  • Diversity and inclusion: We offer annual reimbursements for certain expenses related to disabilities and/or transgender needs.
  • Take a break: Our Sinchers can take a day off on their birthday to celebrate with their loved ones.


Our Hiring Process

In Sinch, we are committed to following a recruitment process that is fair, objective, consistent, and non-discriminatory. Our Talent Acquisition team, together with hiring managers and the rest of the interviewing team, persistently work towards identifying the candidates that best fit each open job, based on Sinch' s hiring needs and candidates' career expectations. We encourage applications from strong candidates with relevant professional backgrounds for this role. Not all applicants will meet all job requirements exactly! Even if you do not meet all job requirements, don't let that stop you from considering Sinch for the next step in your career. We are always open to candidates that could bring new ideas and perspectives to Sinch!

title: Analista De Operações Pleno
description:
ALLOS é uma marca com uma forte herança. São cerca de 50 anos de experiência, transformando o mercado no Brasil. Somos referência em excelência e inovação, com a qualidade e confiança que faz parte da nossa história.


A nova marca surgiu pronta para o futuro, a partir da fusão entre a Aliansce Sonae e a brMalls, em 2023. Mas, essa trajetória começou bem antes.


Tudo começou com a Aliansce, que inaugurou o primeiro shopping da região Nordeste e o segundo do Brasil em 1975. Em 2019, a fusão entre a Aliansce e a Sonae Sierra deu origem à Aliansce Sonae, tornando-se líder na administração de shoppings no Brasil, com 32 empreendimentos. Em 2006, surge a brMalls resultando em um portfólio de 30 ativos presentes nas cinco regiões do país.

title: Production Supervisor/Coordinator - Dry-Mix Mortar & Water-Based Coatings Factory
description:
Core Responsibilities:

1. Production Operations & Management

  • Oversee daily production management for both dry-mix mortar and water-based coatings lines. Schedule production tasks according to plan, ensuring production targets are met on time, in quantity, and to quality standards.
  • Supervise the entire production process from material preparation, feeding, and mixing to packaging and palletizing, ensuring smooth and efficient operations at all stages.
  • Strictly execute the production schedule, optimize production cycle times, and improve equipment utilization and Overall Equipment Effectiveness (OEE).

2. Team Management & Development

  • Manage daily shift operations, including personnel scheduling, task assignment, work guidance, and on-site discipline supervision.
  • Organize and implement job skill training to enhance team members' operational skills, quality awareness, and safety mindset.
  • Conduct performance evaluations for shift personnel, providing continuous feedback and coaching to build a high-performance team.

3. Quality Management & Control

  • Strictly enforce standard operating procedures and work instructions to ensure process standardization and stability.
  • Monitor in-line product quality, perform regular checks at key quality control points, and prevent the occurrence of batch quality issues.
  • Collaborate with the Quality department to analyze, address, and track quality deviations in production, and implement corrective and preventive actions.

4. Safety Production & 5S Management

  • Act as the primary safety responsible person for the shift, implementing company safety rules and regulations, organizing safety training, and conducting hazard identification.
  • Ensure all employees strictly adhere to safe operating procedures, particularly those related to dust explosion prevention and chemical handling, to eliminate safety accidents.
  • Promote and maintain 5S management in the production area, creating a clean, orderly, and safe working environment.

5. Cost Control & Continuous Improvement

  • Monitor and analyze the consumption of raw materials, energy, and auxiliary supplies, striving to reduce production costs.
  • Assist in analyzing equipment failure causes to reduce unplanned downtime.
  • Proactively identify waste in the production process, actively participate in and lead continuous improvement activities (e.G., Kaizen), and propose合理化建议 (rationalization suggestions).

Mandatory Requirements:

  • College diploma or above in Chemical Engineering, Mechanical Engineering, Industrial Engineering, Inorganic Non-metallic Materials, or related fields.
  • Minimum 5 years of production experience in the building materials industry, including at least 2 years in a Production Team Leader or Supervisor role. Must have production management experience in a dry-mix mortar or water-based coatings factory.
  • Familiar with the production processes, equipment principles, and operational procedures for dry-mix mortar/coatings (e.G., mixers, automatic packing machines, powder conveying systems, liquid mixing & dispersing equipment).
  • Strong team leadership, communication, coordination, and on-site problem-solving skills.
  • Strong quality awareness, cost consciousness, and safety mindset.
  • Ability to adapt to a factory work environment and handle work pressure.

Preferred Qualifications:

  • Prior work experience with Sika or Saint-Gobain is highly preferred.

  • Conhecimento com práticas de segurança em cloud computing (AWS, Azure, Google Cloud e OCI) e ambientes on-premises;
  • Conhecimentos em redes e infraestrutura de TI, incluindo configuração, monitoramento e segurança de redes;
  • Experiência em auditoria interna e gestão de riscos, familiaridade com ferramentas específicas para gestão de compliance e risco;
  • Familiaridade com frameworks e normativas de segurança como ISO 27001, NIST, GDPR, SOx e LGPD;
  • Conhecimento emanálise de vulnerabilidades e acompanhamento de testes de penetração;
  • Experiencia em campanhas de conscientização em segurança da informação;

title: Engenheiro De Software Embarcado
description:
Must Have Technical/Functional Skills

· hands-on experience in Automotive ECU development and embedded software

engineering, covering complete V-model lifecycle.

· Deep technical expertise in CAN, UDS, Diagnostics, and automotive communication protocols

with proven track record in software integration and testing.

· Expertise in Embedded C/C++, CAPL, RTOS, Device Drivers, MCAL

· Understanding of Continuous Integration/Continuous (CI/CD) using Jenkins, and version control

systems like Git and SVN.

· Strong understanding of ASPICE, ISO 26262 (Functional Safety), and Agile/Scrum development

methodologies.

· Understanding of AUTOSAR methodology

· Excellent analytical, debugging, and problem-solving abilities with a holistic understanding of

hardware-software co-development.

· Experienced in conducting design/code reviews, and driving technical excellence across cross-

functional teams.


Roles & Responsibilities

1. Embedded Software Design & Development · Lead the design, development, and validation of embedded software for automotive ECUs (Electronic Control Units). · Develop low-level drivers, middleware, and application layers in C/C++ (and/or AUTOSAR environments). · Ensure compliance with automotive software development standards such as MISRA C, and ASPICE. · Integrate software modules and perform debugging on target hardware using tools such as CANoe, Trace32, ETAS INCA, or similar. 2. System & Architecture Definition · Collaborate with system architects to define software architecture aligned with hardware capabilities and vehicle-level requirements. · Participate in requirement analysis and derive detailed software specifications from system-level inputs. · Optimize system performance, memory, and power consumption within embedded constraints. 3. Functional Safety & Quality Compliance · Ensure software development complies with ISO 26262 (Functional Safety) standards. · Support internal and external audits (ASPICE, Functional Safety, or OEM quality audits). 4. Testing, Validation & Verification · Develop and execute unit tests, integration tests, Software-in-the-Loop (SIL) validation. · Automate test procedures where applicable using tools like Python, CAPL, or Vector tools. · Analyze test results, perform root cause analysis, and drive issue resolution to closure. 5. Cross-functional Collaboration · Work closely with hardware and systems, teams for end-to-end ECU development and validation. · Interface with Tier-1 suppliers to clarify requirements, deliverables, and technical queries. 6. Documentation & Configuration Management · Maintain detailed technical documentation: requirements traceability, design specifications, and release notes. · Use version control and configuration management tools (Git, Jira, etc.) effectively. · Ensure all software artifacts meet traceability, review, and release standards.

title: Analista De Comunidade & Customer Success
description:

Você ama conversar com pessoas, engajar grupos, criar vínculos e organizar comunidades?


Gosta de trabalhar com educação, conteúdo, relacionamento e identificar oportunidades dentro da base de clientes?


Então essa vaga é para você.


A Tabelando com Tambellini é referência nacional em educação, eventos e desenvolvimento para o mercado de crédito e cobrança. Atuamos com soluções como a Universidade Tabelando, a Plataforma White Label Tabelando, o Programa G360, além de diversos eventos digitais e presenciais, oferecendo uma jornada completa de aprendizado e transformação.


Estamos em busca de uma pessoa com energia, presença e senso de dono para cuidar das nossas comunidades e ajudar nossos clientes a atingirem resultados reais.


Responsabilidades


Garantir o aumento do engajamento das nossas comunidades (Universidade Tabelando, White Label Tabelando, Programa G360, Partners e Eventos) e transformar não pagantes em pagantes, além de estimular que os clientes comprem mais vezes dentro do ecossistema Tabelando através de relacionamento, comunicação contínua, rituais de comunidade e identificação de oportunidades.


O que você vai fazer no dia a dia


Gestão das Comunidades Tabelando:

  • Mapear, organizar e acompanhar todas as comunidades existentes (Universidade Tabelando, Programa G360, Plataforma White Label Tabelando, Partners e Eventos).
  • Criar e executar rotinas de comunicação (e-mail, WhatsApp, posts, grupos).
  • Desenvolver rituais de comunidade (lives, encontros, newsletters, campanhas).
  • Engajar alunos, clientes e parceiros para aumentar participação e valor percebido.

Customer Success (foco em crescimento interno)

  • Acompanhar clientes do Programa G360 e da Plataforma White Label Tabelando para garantir uso, evolução e sucesso.
  • Apresentar novidades, funcionalidades e melhorias dos produtos.
  • Estimular oportunidades de upgrade, cross-sell e recompra dentro da base.

Universidade Tabelando

  • Comunicar novos cursos, trilhas, formações e lançamentos.
  • Apoiar a movimentação de operadores e gestores dentro da plataforma.

Eventos Tabelando (online e presenciais)

  • Apoiar a execução e comunicação.
  • Garantir engajamento pré, durante e pós-evento.
  • Organizar informações, listas e formulários dos participantes.

Partners Tabelando

  • Acompanhar o cronograma de entregas e ativações.
  • Fazer ponte entre marketing, produto e parceiros.

Dados e Relatórios

  • Monitorar indicadores simples de engajamento.
  • Criar relatórios com insights sobre comportamento das comunidades.


O que Esperamos de Você (Competências Essenciais)

Buscamos alguém que:

  • Ame conversar com pessoas.
  • Comunique com clareza, empatia e didática.
  • Organize e priorize demandas com eficiência.
  • Enxergue claramente as diferentes comunidades e suas intersecções.
  • Tenha facilidade para criar vínculos e conduzir grupos.
  • Tenha boa gestão emocional para lidar com conflitos e pressões.
  • Engaje e ative comunidades com naturalidade.
  • Tenha senso de dono e orientação a resultados.
  • Perceba oportunidades de expansão dentro da base (“cheiro de oportunidade”).


O que não combina com essa vaga

  • Desorganização
  • Dificuldade de priorizar
  • Medo de falar com pessoas
  • Baixa inteligência emocional
  • Estresse rápido com demandas múltiplas
  • Falta de senso de dono
  • Falta de energia para comunidades e grupos


Requisitos Técnicos (Hard Skills)

  • Boa escrita e comunicação digital (WhatsApp, e-mail, posts).
  • Capacidade básica de ler e interpretar dados simples.
  • Experiência com atendimento, comunidades, educação ou CS é diferencial.
  • Organização forte e disciplina de processos.
  • Experiência com plataformas digitais é um bônus.


O que oferecemos

  • Contato direto com a liderança e participação no núcleo estratégico da empresa.
  • Ambiente em crescimento acelerado e com real potencial de evolução profissional.
  • Autonomia para testar ideias, criar projetos e liderar rituais de comunidade.
  • Acesso completo à Universidade Tabelando.
  • Participação em eventos, formações e iniciativas internas.

title: Embedded Software Engineer
description:
Come to one of the biggest IT Services companies in the world!! Here you can transform your career!


Why to join TCS? Here at TCS we believe that people make the difference, that's why we live a culture of unlimited learning full of opportunities for improvement and mutual development. The ideal scenario to expand ideas through the right tools, contributing to our success in a collaborative environment.


We are looking for "Embedded Software Engineer " who wants to learn and transform his career


Responsibility :


-Embedded Software Design & Development · Lead the design, development, and validation of embedded software for automotive ECUs (Electronic Control Units) . · Develop low-level drivers, middleware, and application layers in C/C++ (and/or AUTOSAR environments ).

- Ensure compliance with automotive software development standards such as MISRA C, and ASPICE. · Integrate software modules and perform debugging on target hardware using tools such as CANoe, Trace32, ETAS INCA, or similar.

-System & Architecture Definition · Collaborate with system architects to define software architecture aligned with hardware capabilities and vehicle-level requirements. · Participate in requirement analysis and derive detailed software specifications from system-level inputs. · Optimize system performance, memory, and power consumption within embedded constraints.

-Functional Safety & Quality Compliance · Ensure software development complies with ISO 26262 (Functional Safety) standards. · Support internal and external audits (ASPICE, Functional Safety, or OEM quality audits).

-Testing, Validation & Verification · Develop and execute unit tests, integration tests, Software-in-the-Loop (SIL) validation. · Automate test procedures where applicable using tools like Python, CAPL, or Vector tools. · Analyze test results, perform root cause analysis, and drive issue resolution to closure.

- Cross-functional Collaboration · Work closely with hardware and systems, teams for end-to-end ECU development and validation. · Interface with Tier-1 suppliers to clarify requirements, deliverables, and technical queries.

- Documentation & Configuration Management · Maintain detailed technical documentation: requirements traceability, design specifications, and release notes. · Use version control and configuration management tools (Git, Jira, etc.) effectively. · Ensure all software artifacts meet traceability, review, and release standards.



What can you expect from us?


- Professional development and constant evolution of your skills, always in line with your interests.

- Opportunities to work outside Brazil

- A collaborative, diverse and innovative environment that encourages teamwork.

Estamos em busca de um Analista de Contratos detalhista, responsável e com perfil analítico, para atuar como guardião dos processos de novos contratos de clientes da empresa.


Este profissional será o ponto central na auditoria, monitoria, controle, qualidade, registro e acompanhamento de contratos comerciais e operacionais , garantindo que todos os documentos sejam formalizados corretamente, lançados nos sistemas internos e acompanhados em seus respectivos fluxos financeiros e jurídicos.

title: Engenheiro De Qualificação De Software Embarcado
description:
Engenheiro de Qualificação de Software Embarcado


Formação requerida:

Engenharia de Computação, Elétrica ou Eletrônica, Ciência da Computação ou cursos relacionados.


Descrição da posição:

Será responsável por desenvolver, manter, executar e analisar sistemas de verificação automatizados para sistemas embarcados, garantindo a qualidade e confiabilidade dos nossos produtos.


Responsabilidades:

- Especificar e detalhar testes de verificação de sistemas, incluindo abordagens de caixa-preta e caixa-cinza.

- Analisar a cobertura de testes e garantir a eficácia dos testes realizados.

- Implementar testes manuais e automatizados, empregando códigos na linguagem C#, em ambientes integrados para desenvolvimento, teste e análise de Unidades de Controle Eletrônico (ECUs) individuais e redes completas de ECUs no setor automotivo. Isso inclui a utilização da estação Vector VT System, com o suporte da ferramenta de software Vector CANoe.

- Colaborar estreitamente com equipes de desenvolvimento de software para entender e depurar funcionalidades, garantindo a implementação de ferramentas comuns.

- Configurar, executar e analisar testes utilizando ferramentas automáticas, como Jenkins.

- Gerar relatórios de testes e alimentar as ferramentas de controle de projeto, como Jira, para correções, melhorias e para o desenvolvimento do ambiente de teste.

- Configurar e desenvolver trabalhos automatizados para otimizar os processos de teste.

- Realizar a manutenção dos ambientes e equipamentos de teste para garantir sua eficiência e confiabilidade.

Requisitos:

- Experiência comprovada em ambientes de testes de verificação, preferencialmente em empresas do setor automotivo.

- Fluência em inglês, com habilidade para participar de reuniões diárias no idioma.

title: Engenheiro de Dados | Node.js • Scala • Databricks
description:
Quem Somos

A Dexian, lançada em 2023, tem presença global e traz consigo quase 30 anos de experiência através de suas companhias legadas, principalmente da combinação da DISYS e Signature Consultants.

Iniciamos no Brasil 2007 como DISYS e, de lá para cá, conquistamos mais de 50 clientes de diferentes setores da economia. Como Dexian, passamos a ser uma das maiores empresas de contratação e solução de TI e estamos liderando a indústria por meio de entrega de serviços exclusivos que combina escala global, recursos de serviço completo e agilidade tática para modernizar modelos de contratação, avançar em soluções de mão-de-obra e transformar a infraestrutura tecnológica. Contamos com escritórios estrategicamente localizados em quatro grandes capitais: Curitiba (PR), Porto Alegre (RS), Rio de Janeiro (RJ) e São Paulo (SP). Assim, conseguimos nos manter próximos dos nossos clientes e consultores. Também somos uma Minority Owner Company e nos sentimos orgulhosos de termos nascido na diversidade.

O que esperar de nós

Pessoas estão no centro de nossa estratégia e compõem o nosso maior capital. Temos compromisso de atrair, reter os maiores e melhores talentos e construir conexões reais para a vida. Por isso, atuamos como ponte entre profissionais altamente qualificados e oportunidades consistentes e prósperas. Acreditamos que, trazer o talento, a tecnologia e as organizações certas juntos, ajuda a desbloquear resultados transformadores e alcançar novos níveis de sucessos para os clientes que atendemos e os consultores que contratamos. E para isso, cinco valores fundamentais nos guiam: Integridade, Transparencia, Autenticidade, Engenhosidade e Empatia. Compartilha dos mesmos valores, aqui é seu lugar! Que tal desenvolver sua carreira conosco?

Na Dexian, valorizamos a diversidade.

Acreditamos que diferentes perspectivas, experiências e trajetórias impulsionam a inovação e fortalecem conexões. Por isso, nosso processo de contratação é inclusivo, aberto a candidatos de todas as identidades, habilidades e histórias. Aqui, o que importa é o talento.

Nosso Cliente

Atuação em uma empresa de grande porte do setor financeiro, com presença nacional e internacional, em um ambiente moderno, colaborativo e orientado a dados.

Buscamos um profissional com foco em Engenharia de Dados, que possua background em desenvolvimento backend, especialmente com Node.js, Scala e Databricks, para atuar em projetos desafiadores e de alto impacto tecnológico.

O que você precisa ter

  • Experiência sólida em Scala, preferencialmente e Databricks.
  • Experiência prática em Node.js, com foco em microserviços e APIs REST.
  • Vivência em engenharia de dados, especialmente com stream processing e integração entre sistemas.
  • Conhecimentos em Azure (Data Lake, Databricks, Functions, Containers).
  • Experiência com Kafka, EventHub e Service Bus.
  • Conhecimento em bancos de dados relacionais e não relacionais.
  • Familiaridade com Docker, Git/GitLab, CI/CD e boas práticas de versionamento.
  • Domínio de DDD, TDD e arquitetura de microsserviços.
  • Perfil colaborativo, analítico e foco em resultados.

O que esperar do seu dia a dia de trabalho

  • Atuar em projetos de engenharia de dados e integração de grandes volumes de informação.
  • Desenvolver e manter pipelines de dados em Scala e Databricks
  • Criar e evoluir serviços backend e APIs em Node.js, integrando-os a fluxos de dados e aplicações financeiras.
  • Projetar e otimizar modelos de dados em bancos relacionais e não relacionais (MySQL, PostgreSQL, MongoDB, SQL Server).
  • Implementar processos de ingestão e transformação de dados utilizando Kafka, EventHub e Service Bus.
  • Automatizar e gerenciar pipelines CI/CD, garantindo qualidade e rastreabilidade dos entregáveis.
  • Atuar em ambientes cloud (Azure), configurando recursos e monitorando performance.
  • Colaborar com times multidisciplinares de engenharia, produto e dados para garantir escalabilidade, segurança e performance das soluções.

Onde você vai trabalhar?

No conforto da sua casa. Regime 100% Home Office

CLT

Benefícios para você

* Vale Refeição

* Vale Alimentação

* Assistência Médica

Além disso, oferecemos :
